data_fields.name: hazard_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 (centre plus four diagonals; donor intent at calls 72-76)

best_idea: A destroyed unit starts a fixed timed blast; when the blast ends it leaves a five-cell hazard (centre plus four diagonal neighbours), and any live unit within a small Manhattan radius is destroyed in the same way, so one death can chain into a group.
decision_why: A timed death blast that leaves a hazard and chains to nearby units fits the engine's one-death path and zones-as-data; we keep it, but fix the ignored arguments and the wrong diagonal list, and keep the animation client-only.
acceptance: In a fight, an enemy that dies within 30 px (Manhattan) of another enemy sets it off in the same tick; the death shows a six-frame blast over about 12 sim ticks; the engine marks five distinct cells as hazard, and a server test asserts exactly those five cells change and the chained enemy dies in the tick its neighbour's blast starts.
